title: Can Your THUMB Bend Back Like a Hitchhiker's? 👍
description:
Give a thumbs up and bend just the tip of your thumb back. Barely moved? A tough strap on the palm side of that joint catches it, like a seatbelt. In people with looser joints that strap gives more, like a bungee cord, and the tip curls back into a hitchhiker's hook.
Straight or bendy?

Bonus: the school idea that there are only two kinds of thumbs, straight or "hitchhiker's", is a myth. X-rays of 294 people found every angle in between (Harris and Joseph, 1949). The usual dividing line, 50 degrees, was picked in a 1953 study (Glass and Kistler). And your two thumbs don't always match.
